snapshot_note: Snapshot taken 2026-10-25 ~00:46 UTC from live Solana mainnet RPC. Client attribution is the node's self-reported gossip `clientId` from getClusterNodes, cross-checked against the reported `version` string. Stake figures are activated stake at snapshot time. The probe tool re-reads clientId + version live at campaign time (see `probe schedule`); if a target has switched client or gone delinquent, substitute an alternate and record the change in the report.

Stakewiz API (api.stakewiz.com/validators) for operator names, fetched 2026-10-25
docs.firedancer.io getting-started guide (Firedancer release v26.10.4) corroborating the 26.10.x version line as Firedancer
